title: Bursa Malaysia to trade range-bound this week on continued cautious sentiment | The Star
text:
Bursa Malaysia to trade range-bound this week on continued cautious sentiment | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR, Feb 6 (Bernama): Bursa Malaysia is expected to trade range-bound this week as investor sentiment is likely to remain cautious due to market volatility with the key index moving in a tight range, an analyst said.
Rakuten Trade Sdn Bhd vice-president of equity research Thong Pak Leng said the benchmark FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) is anticipated to hover within the 1,515-1,530 range, with immediate resistance at 1,530 and support at 1,500.
